data.fund_name: SBI Nifty50 Equal Weight Index Fund
data.fund_type: An open-ended equity scheme replicating/tracking NIFTY50 Equal Weight Index
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide returns that correspond to the total returns of the securities as represented by the underlying index, subject to tracking errors.However there is no guarantee or assurance that the investment objective of the scheme would be achieved.
data.exit_load: For exit on or before 15 days from the date of allotment – 0.25%; For exit after 15 days from the date of allotment – Nil
